calls: 16 PixelLab calls, ~1.6 generations (jobs in tools/.intake/bench/jobs.txt, not tracked)

tidy_and_stray_pixels.why: PixelLab correct_pixelart strength 0.1 failed the gates on 6/6: re-renders the sprite (48 -> 801..3346 colours, 5-26% of pixels changed outside the defect area). Do not use it on finished sprites.

reduce_colours.why: reduce_colors with a palette passes the gates 6/6 but only because the palette was the script's own, so it is a tie (differs from the script by 0-222 px) at 1 paid call per asset. Auto palette (no palette given) failed 4/4: 30-87% of pixels recoloured.
reduce_colours.maybe_later: reduce_colors with palette_image on a whole animation sheet to lock frames to one palette; not tested.

not_tested: inpaint_image / edit_image (10 generations each, need a defect mask we cannot detect yet)
repeatability (the 4 spare calls went to the auto-palette check)
revisit_when: PixelLab changes these tools, or a new defect class appears (the one-off compare harness was deleted; gates: silhouette IoU >= 0.97, <= 2% pixels changed outside the defect area, <= 1% colours not in the original, no semi alpha)
